five_view_personal_pixel_review.finding: 13F stepped front mass, distinct lower narrow wing now about two floor levels below major roof, staggered facade pattern, angled low skirt and external entry stair. Finite upper return walls and roof heights retained; no generic rectangular replacement.

Long rear envelope and short side retained. Corrected near-end broad thick-white-framed upper opening and ground-reaching entry are visible. Other rear middle/upper window repeats and low openings remain disclosed approximations, not individually documented.
Main eleven upper window rows above the two-level skirt versus corrected nine rows in the intermediate narrow wing express observed p56 two-floor roof drop. No cropped top, base or stair.

Stepped plan, diagonal podium perimeter, open recessed roof areas, separated green terraces, raised central equipment/PV volume and end screen remain distinct. Small roof equipment and exact PV layout are intentionally simplified, not fully surveyed.

Gym-side upper short facade and principal stepped envelope are consistent with p58 contextual views; no adjacent gym or Xuesi geometry included. Fine slots and lower side openings are explicitly approximate.

independent_computational_checks.note: Independent read-only raw/coordinate/hash/camera checks. Does not repeat builder vertex-link, 951-layer slicing, lib3mf edits or Blender edits; does not certify actual manufacture.

limitations: This is a visual exterior approximation, not a dimensionally surveyed or construction-ready building model.
Source success includes only official 3F/4F/6F/7F plans. Failed/truncated 5F/8F–13F files were not used or treated as read.
Rear middle/upper window layouts, gym-side lower small openings, exact facade widths, recess depths, rail counts, rooftop equipment/PV counts and colors are approximations.
Official p58 views close primary mass boundaries but are not full-resolution complete rear facade surveys.
PDF created 2021-10-01; official inauguration/name dated 2021-10-23. Original photograph capture dates not established; 2024 archive date is not capture date.
Neutral daylight-inspired white/gray/dark/opaque blue-gray material proxies; warm night lighting is not interpreted as brown brick pigmentation.
Display sealing/plinth is not real B2, foundation or ground contour. Interior rooms and hidden systems omitted.
Raw/strict/951-layer and edit/reopen checks are engineering checks, not physical-print success, support-free certification, or guarantee of all local wall thicknesses.
This reviewer re-opened final five PNGs and performed independent raw/hash/coordinate/camera/rebuild comparisons, but did not re-execute Blender or all builder manufacturing tests.
